cohort: One obstetric patient who underwent spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
finding: Intracranial subdural hematoma is a rare but serious complication following spinal anesthesia, requiring vigilance even if initially mimicking post-dural puncture headache.
mod_finding: A delayed-onset subdural hematoma occurred following spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
followup_time: 14 days post-spinal anesthesia for the onset of the complication
